parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence, and same-sex conduct was decriminalised in 2018, so there is no criminalisation of the visitor and no documented police targeting, raids, or extortion. No facility ban or birth-sex custody rule is shown in force — the 2018 judicial protocol merely records that no safe prison units exist and leaves placement to a sentencing recommendation, which the dossier flags as undocumented practice (an open question, not a proven exposure). Against that: a documented pattern of identity-targeted predation on LGBT people via fake dating-app lures (armed robbery, beatings, sexual assault, two cases in one week in late 2024), no hate-crime category, advocacy reports of beatings with most incidents unreported, and thin/no functional recourse. An unenforced immigration ban on homosexual non-citizens is a latent tangential statute only. Attitude surveys are stale (2009/2012) and give no weight. Sits above the 0.45 tier (which requires a documented unremedied universal-exposure practice) but below reduced-risk anchors that show documented acceptance or working remedies — neither is present here.
